1.text: You begin your journey at the mouth of a labrinth of shipping containers. There is an eeriness to this place but you progress anyway.

choices.text: The minuete you enter you are confronted by a choice of left or right. You have a feeling this will be the simplest choice of the journey. You choose left.
choices.label: Continue this way

choices.text: The minuete you enter you are confronted by a choice of left or right. You have a feeling this will be the simplest choice of the journey. You choose right.
choices.label: Continue this way

3.text: This turn has lead to another so you continue but before this you notice the breeze stop and nothing but faint creaking is all you hear.

4.text: As you turn the abandonment of this place becomes more and more obvious. Off-center containers, broken lights and the smell of rust in the air..

5.text: You reach another bend and as you do you see containers toppled over. A wave of caution hits you and now every creak is a sign of further collapse.

choices.text: Now you must decide between the dark, narrow and toppled path to the left or the seemingly stable path forward. You choose risk and take the left.
choices.label: Continue this way

choices.text: Now you must decide between the dark, narrow and toppled path to the left or the seemingly stable path forward. You choose safety and take the right.
choices.label: Continue this way

7.text: This path is fear inducing. The containers about hanging on by a thread. Despite this you push forward with speed in your step.

8.text: At the end of the tunnel is a ladder. You fear for your life turning back so you climb it to reach the next stage of your journey.

choices.text: You reach the top of the ladder and the path splits. Both will lead you to a bridge of winding containers but you instinctually choose left.
choices.label: Continue this way

choices.text: You reach the top of the ladder and the path splits. Both will lead you to a bridge of winding containers but you instinctually choose right.
choices.label: Continue this way

10.text: As you turn left you notice a crane towering over you. With the state of the rest of this place the idea of it falling on top of you is not out of the question.

11.text: With your mind stuck on the crane you reach another ladder which takes you up yet another level of containers. As you climb all fear from the crane dissapears and you begin to feel like you'vr almost reached your goal.

12.text: You reach the top and realise this was mearly a small hurdle in the path and jumping down would be easy. Before you jump you notice the only open container you've seen and feel that this is where you must go.

13.text: Before you enter you take a breath and prepare for the end of your pilgrimage.
13.note: Placeholder text — replace with real copy once written.

14.text: After turning right you see the faint image of an open container and realise this is where you must go.

15.text: Continuing forward you see the path is disrupted by a tilted container. You can make this jump easily but you still worry about falling. The idea of being so close to your goal forces you forward.

16.text: You approach the open container but before you reach the entrance you question is this is the right path. After a moment of doubt an overwhelming feeling of reassurance hits you and you continue.

17.text: As you turn right an echoing sound of wind bellows out. Although this scres you, you continue forward.

18.text: You turn the corner and the wind hits you. The containers have made an unintentional windtunnel. Each step is heavy but you push forward anyway.

choices.text: You are given another choice. You see an opening to you left and a narrow tilting path to your right. You feel confident in choosing the opening.
choices.label: Continue this way

choices.text: You are given another choice. You see an opening to you left and a narrow tilting path to your right. You feel confident in choosing the tight path.
choices.label: Continue this way

20.text: The confidence you felt slowing drains out of you with every step down this cluttered path. Despite this you push forward.

21.text: Pushing through the clutter was worth it as you turn left and see a seemingly stable and secure pathwith nothing but a slight breeze.

22.text: This path is long but feels like the calm before the storm of a more anxiety filled journey to come. You slowly push forward savoring the calm as long as you can.

23.text: You reach a large opening. Being here feels both secure and overwhelming. In this opening you see only one path forward so you take it.

24.text: As you push forward you see a moved container and are not sure if you gat get past it but you approach it to see.

25.text: The gap is wide enough side step through so you tilt you body and push forward into what feels like might be a dead end.

26.text: Lucky for you as you squeeze through the gap there is a ladder which leads to what you can barely make out as an open container. The only one you've seen. You feel that this is where you were meant to go.

27.text: After moving forward you peak the corner to a large opening. There is something ominous about the silence within it but you must be confidence in your choices and push forward.

28.text: You choose the safer option but before stepping into it you peak around the corner and see a felled container. Despite this you feel confidence int his decision and go forward.

choices.text: Once in the opening you see two paths in front of you. A small gap between containers or a ladder taking you on top of them. You feel being high up will show the path you need to take.
choices.label: Continue this way

choices.text: Once in the opening you see two paths in front of you. A small gap between containers or a ladder taking you on top of them. You feel the gap was made on purpose so you squeeze through.
choices.label: Continue this way

30.text: You climb the ladder and reach a seemingly simple path ahead. The path leads to an open container, the only one you've seen. You feel like that is where you need to go.

31.text: As you walk forward you look around confident your journey is nearly done but as you do one of your steps causes the container to buckle. Although just making you stumble, all confidence in your security leaves your body. You slowly continue forward.

32.text: You pass through the small gap feeling weirdly confident in this choice of path. You're sensing that you are appoaching a climax to your journey.

33.text: The opening you have reached is eearily silent except for the odd creaking of metal. Despite the fear of this you push forward.
